tickets.title: Prepare care-cost runway projection for Cloudpuddle household
tickets.text: Prepare a care-cost runway projection for Helena and Martin Cloudpuddle comparing the current Pocket Lantern Home Care aide schedule (32 hours/week at $38/hour) with a higher-coverage scenario. Show when the $142,000 in Teacup Comet Bank cash reserves would require an increased withdrawal from the joint taxable account at Velvet Acorn Custody (~$615,000).
